analysis: Static PE/disassembly; no runtime execution or hook installed by this audit.

rules: Replace only verified five-byte E8 call using near relay if target out of signed32-bit range. No function prologue detour required.
Wrapper draws notice first, then calls original Render exactly once even when notice closed or not yet ready.
Do not call ImGui from loader/background worker. Wrapper executes synchronously on original Present/render thread with the original current context.
NewFrame is already completed; do not call it again. After original Render, frame is finalized and widget calls are too late.

readiness.sequence: At end of successful Present path, if flag false increment counter; when counter==75 call LE::GUI::UIInitDoneNotify, then set flag=1. Render hook earlier in same function sees true from the next successful frame (frame76).
readiness.caveat: InitDone means original LE UI readiness, not proof career/player database is loaded.

dx11_search.scope: Entire .text direct E8 calls targeting identified ImGui Render0x2766A0
dx11_search.conclusion: No second direct Render call found. DX11 support not demonstrated; do not claim support or invent a hook address.

popup_lifecycle: After readiness gate, OpenPopup stable id once.
Each frame call SetNextWindowPos as desired then BeginPopupModal with same stable id.
If BeginPopupModal returns true: TextUnformatted/QR/widgets; close button calls CloseCurrentPopup and records dismissed; then EndPopup.
If BeginPopupModal returns false, do not EndPopup.
